//: OPS-004: an Invariant for every repository.
text: When a denial, hook, check or auth error blocks you, fix the cause or report it; never route around it (other tool, shell, credential, settings edit, `--no-verify`).
why: Blocked agents retry with skip flags, another shell, another credential or an edited setting.
enforced_by: Claude Code auto mode, which stops a session after repeated denials
required checks, which run on the server and cannot be skipped
to_add: agent configuration paths the agent cannot write
